records.name: event.stage.view.form
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
            <form string="Events Stage">
                <sheet>
                    <group>
                        <group>
                            <field name="name" placeholder="e.g. "Promoting""/>
                            <field name="pipe_end"/>
                        </group>
                        <group>
                            <field name="fold"/>
                            <field name="sequence"/>
                        </group>
                    </group>
                    <group string="Add a description that will appear as a tooltip for this stage">
                        <field name="description" placeholder="Add a description..." nolabel="1" colspan="2"/>
                    </group>
                </sheet>
            </form>
        </field>

records.name: event.stage.view.list
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
            <list string="Events Stage">
                <field name="sequence" widget="handle"/>
                <field name="name"/>
            </list>
        </field>
